_about: N002T-v3 test vectors for N002A-identity-wire-v2.3.md. ECDSA signatures are randomized; vectors assert 'verifiable', never signature bytes. Keys in test-keys.json are PUBLIC TEST KEYS.
_signature_format: ECDSA P-256 + SHA-256 over UTF-8(signing input); signature = IEEE P1363 r||s (64 bytes); standard base64 WITH padding; canonical encoding required (decode→encode must round-trip)
spec: N002A-identity-wire-v2.3.md (§4.1 canonical SPKI / signature format / base64; §5.3 signing inputs incl. receipt; §6.4; §6.6; §6.7 evaluation order; §8.4 text rules)
